story_title: As a registered user, I want to reset my password by email so that I can regain access to my account

acceptance_criteria.text: Given I am on the login page, when I click 'Forgot password' and enter my registered email, then I receive a reset link by email.
The reset link expires after 30 minutes.
The new password must be at least 8 characters and contain a number.

test_cases.title: Reset link is sent to a registered email
test_cases.preconditions:
User account exists for test.user@example.com and is active.
User is logged out.
test_cases.expected_result:
Confirmation message 'If this email is registered, a reset link has been sent' is shown.
A reset email arrives within 2 minutes containing a single-use reset link.

test_cases.title: Unregistered email shows the same message and sends no email
test_cases.expected_result:
The same confirmation message as TC01 is shown (no hint that the account does not exist).
No email is sent.

test_cases.title: Reset link works at 29 minutes
test_cases.preconditions: A reset link was requested for test.user@example.com 29 minutes ago (or token created_at set to now minus 29 min in the test DB).
steps: Open the reset link from the email
Enter a valid new password in both fields
test_cases.expected_result: Password is updated and the user is redirected to the login page with a success message.

test_cases.title: Reset link is rejected after 30 minutes
test_cases.preconditions: A reset link was requested 31 minutes ago (or token created_at set to now minus 31 min).
steps: Open the reset link from the email
test_cases.expected_result:
Page shows 'This reset link has expired' with a button to request a new link.
Password fields are not shown.

test_cases.title: Password with 7 characters is rejected
test_cases.preconditions: User has opened a valid, unexpired reset link.
steps: Enter the new password in both fields
test_cases.expected_result:
Validation error 'Password must be at least 8 characters and contain a number' is shown.
Password is not changed.

test_cases.title: Password without a number is rejected
test_cases.preconditions: User has opened a valid, unexpired reset link.
steps: Enter the new password in both fields
test_cases.expected_result:
Validation error 'Password must be at least 8 characters and contain a number' is shown.
Password is not changed.

open_questions: AC2 says the link expires after 30 minutes, but ResetTokenService.java uses TOKEN_TTL_MINUTES = 60. Which is correct?
Can a reset link be used more than once? The code invalidates the token after use, but no acceptance criterion states this.
